task.title: Check DITA on every pull request
task.shortdesc: Add the action to a repository, so a pull request that breaks a key, a conref, a link or an image fails with the file, the line and the fix.

step.cmd: Create .github/workflows/dita.yml in the repository that holds your DITA.
Add a job that checks out the repository and runs the action on your root map:

info.codeblock: on: pull_request jobs: dita: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: siddharthraop/Manifest/action@main with: map: docs/product.ditamap

stepresult.p: Each problem is annotated on the changed file and line, with the fix.
